skins.name: Celestial Crane
skins.description: Outfit made from high-quality Yanese brocade, accompanied with a long ribbon of gauze. At Shamare's request, the remaining fabric was used to make a new look for Morte as well.

skins.name: Caged Singer
skins.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will spurn not the cage but accept her shackles, so she might continue to sing.

skins.name: Magician of Passion
skins.code: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Magician of Passion
skins.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. For as easily as she will scry your hearts, so one can scarcely scry hers.

skins.name: Marionette's Id
skins.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. By her own fingers she will puppet the strings, unseal the closed box, and grant freedom to every doll.

skins.name: Master of Melodia
skins.code: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Master of Melodia
skins.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She is the Creator of the Haven, Ave Mujica . She awaits in stilled elegance, that she would entice her audience unto this world.

skins.name: Moonlight Executioner
skins.description: Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. She will carry out her mission wordlessly, so she might protect the place where she truly belongs.
